hints.title: Three Transition Types
hints.text: From index i, you can jump to i + 1, i - 1, or any index j with arr[i] == arr[j].

hints.title: Group Equal Values
hints.text: Precompute a map from value to list of indices having that value.

hints.title: Clear Visited Value Buckets
hints.text: Once all indices of value arr[i] have been enqueued, clear the bucket to prevent redundant scans.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-iterating through equal value indices without clearing leads to quadratic O(N^2) time on identical arrays.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Deleting graph[arr[i]] immediately after first expansion bounds edge traversals to linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies the equal-value bucket clearing optimization in BFS.
complexity.notes: Essential optimization: clear graph bucket after visiting its members.
